method.primary_acquisition: Direct urllib GET of live GitHub Trending HTML; read-only gh GraphQL metadata and pinned blobs; REST star history and Git Trees. No search snippet admitted as a metric.
method.selection: All live monthly page rows were parsed. Exclude anthropics/skills because licensing not established; add one in-window-created, explicitly licensed repo. Analyst operational signal: at least 2,000 stars created in selected provider date bins, not a universal rapid-growth definition.
method.sampling: Purposive monthly page + first eight star-ranked new-repo search results; not a representative or exhaustive GitHub-wide survey.
method.history_semantics: GitHub documents stars created per day, grouped by calendar week, Sunday first. Week and day boundaries need not align with UTC. Counts are not reconstructed exact UTC event counts or net retained-star changes.
method.arithmetic: All sums, counts, sorting, ratios, date conversions, and hashes computed in Python from observed data.

monthly.scope: GitHub label: stars this month; not assumed equal to requested dates

history.interval_interpretation: Provider-calendar bins labelled 2026-10-17 through 2026-11-16, inclusive. Labels derived from week epoch + Sunday-first index; not an exact UTC interval.

latest_nonpartial_comparison.metric_kind: derived; provider-day bins; no causal or forecast interpretation
